claims: No. 6 seed Baylor defeated No. 11 seed Nebraska 67-62 in the first round of the 2026 NCAA Women’s Basketball Tournament on March 20, 2026.
Baylor rallied from a nine-point fourth-quarter deficit.
Baylor outscored Nebraska 26-15 in the final 10 minutes.
Baylor advanced to the second round.
Taliah Scott led Baylor with 15 points.
Britt Prince scored 27 points for Nebraska.
The game was at Cameron Indoor Stadium, Durham, N.C.
Baylor capitalized on a flagrant foul call in the fourth quarter to take the lead for good.
Baylor plays No. 3 seed Duke on Sunday.
Baylor led 19-11 after the first quarter.
Nebraska took a lead just before halftime.
Nebraska entered the fourth quarter with a six-point advantage.
Baylor’s full-court press forced six turnovers.
